scope: one mirrored-upper closed causal diagnostic; no retry/training/compensation/gain tuning/hardware/Git/cloud

diagnostic_rules.functional: Bmirror startup/move/stop/full gates must be reported
diagnostic_rules.upper: Bmirror tracking is scored against its own mirrored target; compare B1 without changing thresholds

diagnostic_rules.causal_heading: compare signed yaw progress deltas; sign-flip with each magnitude>=0.03rad is mirror-responsive
diagnostic_rules.contact_slip: report same Phase34 1kHz official collision agreement/slip metrics for all arms
diagnostic_rules.claim: causal diagnostic only; no promotion or compensation tuning from this episode

truth_boundary: official MuJoCo collision/contact-force model truth, not hardware GRF/COP
